events.title: CVE-2024-0244 – A heap buffer overflow in the Canon MF753Cdw printer
events.summary: A heap buffer overflow in the Canon MF753Cdw printer allows unauthenticated attackers to trigger an arbitrary free, potentially leading to remote code execution.
events.why_it_matters: The vulnerability has a CVSS score of 9.8 and is classified as critical, meaning attackers could potentially execute arbitrary code on affected printers without authentication.

claims.text: CVE-2024-0244 is rated 9.8 (critical) under CVSS 3.1 by the CNA that assigned it.
FIRST's EPSS puts the chance of CVE-2024-0244 being exploited in the next 30 days at 1.4%.

events.summary: A store in Auckland vibe-coded itself a new website. Within hours, its inventory had somehow expanded to include a pair of crusty socks, an $850 banana, and all of New Zealand's national parks. What could possibly have gone wrong? Meanwhile, a hacker collective backed a truck into one of the license-plate-reading Flock safety cameras popping up on American street corners, and took a very close look inside. All this and more in episode 486 of the "Smashing Security" podcast with cybersecurity expert and keynote speaker Graham Cluley, and special guest Dave Bittner.
